# OpenAgent

> Digital marketing for growing businesses: websites, Shopify stores, SEO, social media, Meta, Google, TikTok and ChatGPT ads, lead generation and SaaS marketing. Founded and led by Abeer Nasir, with a small team of specialists.

OpenAgent helps brands, e-commerce businesses, B2B companies and small businesses get found, generate leads and grow online with websites, SEO, social media, paid advertising and marketing automation. Work is scoped in writing before it starts.
